name: socialmorning
description: A functional clone of 小宇宙 (Xiaoyuzhou FM): a podcast client whose reason to exist is the social layer over listening.

scripts.postinstall: if [ -x node_modules/.bin/patch-package ]; then patch-package; else echo 'postinstall: patch-package not installed (production install) — skipped'; fi
scripts.check:health: knip --include files,dependencies,devDependencies,unlisted,unresolved,binaries,duplicates --max-issues 89 --no-progress && depcruise apps packages --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ignore-known --output-type err && jscpd apps packages --silent --threshold 0.6 --format "typescript,tsx,javascript,jsx" --ignore "**/*.test.ts,**/*.test.tsx,**/*.json,**/ios/**,**/android/**,**/node_modules/**,**/dist/**,**/*.d.ts,**/__mocks__/**,**/*.generated.*" --min-tokens 70
